issues.title: Proposed work: complete intake example
issues.body:
### Problem
Maintainers need a safe read-only way to understand proposed-work intake quality.

### Evidence
The proposed-work label can include complete, vague, routed, rejected, pending, and paid examples.

### Proposed work
Generate a triage report without mutating GitHub labels, comments, bounties, or payouts.

### Expected value
Maintainers can decide what needs more evidence and what should not become a duplicate bounty.

### Possible acceptance criteria
The report includes readiness gaps, routed bounty references, payment status separation, and next actions.

### Evidence or tests required
Run pytest for fixture coverage and a docs smoke check.

### Duplicate search
Search related proposed-work issues before opening a new bounty.

### Out of scope
No payout execution, label changes, bounty creation, private API mutation, or broad rewrite.

issues.title: Proposed work: pending payout example
issues.body:
### Problem
Accepted work can be queued but not paid yet.

### Evidence
Pending pay_bounty proposals are public but are not proof-backed payments.

### Proposed work
Keep pending payout proposals separate from paid rows.

### Expected value
Contributors do not confuse queued review with received payment.

### Possible acceptance criteria
The report marks this row as pending_payout, not proof_backed_paid.

### Evidence or tests required
Fixture test with a pending proposal source URL.

### Duplicate search
This covers a payment-state example only.

### Out of scope
No payout execution or treasury mutation.

comments.body: Accepted for review; pending proposal only.

issues.title: Proposed work: paid proof example
issues.body:
### Problem
Proof-backed payments must not be mixed with pending payout proposals.

### Evidence
A public proof URL exists for this issue.

### Proposed work
Mark this row as proof_backed_paid.

### Expected value
Maintainers can reconcile already-paid work without duplicate payout language.

### Possible acceptance criteria
The report links the proof and avoids pending wording.

### Evidence or tests required
Fixture test with a proof source URL.

### Duplicate search
This covers a paid-state example only.

### Out of scope
No duplicate claim or new bounty.
